{{nihongo|'''Nahaka Shrine'''|那波加神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

Until the {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji period}}, the principal deity was said to be {{ill|Ukanomitama|lt=Ukanomitama|Q3080728|qid=Q3080728|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama-no-Mikoto}}.

=== History ===
According to shrine tradition, Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto descended here and was enshrined from ancient times. A deer appeared and carried rice seedlings to help the now-elderly deity’s farming work; this is said to be origin of shrine/place name “Noka (Nahaka/Nōka).” Nearby remain the Noka kofun cluster and Hōkō-ji kofun cluster.

In {{ill|851|Q29966|qid=Q29966}} ({{ill|Ninju|Q1373077|qid=Q1373077}} 1), after {{ill|Abo no Imao|Q11657229|qid=Q11657229|lt=Otsuki no Sukune Imao}} received Ogoto-shō, this shrine and {{ill|Ogoto Shrine (Otsu)|Q11659231|qid=Q11659231|lt=Ogoto Shrine}} were revered as clan shrines of the {{ill|Ozuki clan|Q11462133|qid=Q11462133}}. Their clan temple {{ill|Hōkō-ji Temple|Q11555028|qid=Q11555028|lt=Hōkō-ji}} became this shrine’s {{ill|Bettō-ji|Q11396755|qid=Q11396755}}.

In the '{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}' '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}' (Enchō 5, {{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}), it appears in {{ill|Shiga District, Shiga|fa|منطقه شیگا، شیگا|ja|滋賀郡|zh|滋賀郡|qid=Q7496289}} of {{ill|Ōmi Province|Q843882|qid=Q843882}} as “Nahaka Shrine,” and is ranked {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.

In {{ill|1571|Q6666|qid=Q6666}} ({{ill|Genki (era)|Q1145064|qid=Q1145064}} 2), buildings were burned in {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|Q171411|qid=Q171411}}’s {{ill|Siege of Mount Hiei|Q10748887|qid=Q10748887}}, and rebuilt in {{ill|1607|Q6756|qid=Q6756}} ({{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} 12).

In October {{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}} (Meiji 9), it was ranked {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}} under the modern shrine rank system, promoted to {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}} in January {{ill|1895|Q7844|qid=Q7844}}, then to {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Prefectural Shrine}} in May {{ill|1902|Q2043|qid=Q2043}}.

=== Precincts ===
The main shrine is called “Lower Shrine,” versus Nahaka Aramitama Shrine called “Upper Shrine.”

=== Local information ===
* Nahaka Shrine (Lower Shrine): Noka 1-8-1, Ōtsu, Shiga
* Nahaka Aramitama Shrine (Upper Shrine): Noka 1-9-14, Ōtsu, Shiga

; Access
* Rail: JR West {{ill|Kosei Line|Q599974|qid=Q599974}}, {{ill|Ogoto-onsen Station|Q5367599|qid=Q5367599}} or {{ill|Hieizan Sakamoto Station|Q5367380|qid=Q5367380}} (about 15 min walk)
* Bus: from {{ill|Biwako-Hamaōtsu Station|Q5644181|qid=Q5644181}} by {{ill|Kojak Bus|Q11551295|qid=Q11551295}} bus (to Katata), get off at “Noka,” then 3 min walk
